data.name: Phantom Beasts - Redemption
data.detailed_description:
ST. PETERSBURG, FLORIDA. 2059

A post apocalyptic dystopia. The city has become a quarantine zone. Sealed off, left to rot and crawling with threats that used to be human. 

You are Hunter, a mercenary ex-cop confronting a past he can’t outrun, armed with everything he can carry. The only allies he has on his journey are the mysterious creatures that appeared after the nuclear disaster - the Phantom Beasts. 

What are the Phantom Beasts? The truth lies on the other side of the wasteland.

HIGH-OCTANE CYBERPUNK ACTION

Combat and movement in Phantom Beasts - Redemption is fast, fluid and relentless. Sprint, dash, slide, double jump and take cover as enemy waves surround you. Every weapon has weight, every hit has a consequence and every time you think you’ve got the situation under control, something new is on its way.

Engineered for pick-up-and-play gameplay and delivering an intense hit of chaotic, hyperviolent action whenever you need it. In order to survive, you’ll need to use quick reflexes, deploy smart tactics and know exactly when to let your Beast of the leash.

TRAIN YOUR BEASTS TO UNLEASH CHAOS

In this world, your Phantom Beast companions are what make all the difference. Creatures that are unpredictable, powerful and shaped by the way you interact with them. They’ll transform the way every fight plays out.

Each Beast has their own unique set of skills and passive abilities, becoming more powerful as your bond level with them increases. The real question is where they came from in the first place. 


BUILD YOUR HUNTER

Upgrade the abilities of Hunter and the Phantom Beasts with permanent skill tree unlocks. Become deadlier than ever. 

From mobility boosts and increased maximum health to weapon power and extra explosive damage, your enemies won’t know what hit them.


FEATURES 

  • 2.5D Cyberpunk Action Shooter. Set in a post-apocalyptic quarantine zone, there’s plenty of secrets to be revealed among the ruins.

  • Four Phantom Beast companions. Each with its own unique passive and special abilities that transform combat in distinct, spectacular ways.

  • Explosive, gore-filled gunplay. Satisfying weapon feedback that lets you dispatch enemies in over the top, visceral ways.

  • Fluid movement system. Navigate the dangers of 2059 with movement designed for fast, expressive, reactive combat. 

  • Six distinct weapons. From classics like the AK-47 rifle and SPAS-12 shotgun to shield-piercing energy weapons like the Laser Gun and Plasma SMG.

  • Persistent skill tree upgrades. Power up Hunter, Mercenary and Beast Connection skills to become unstoppable.

  • Tactical depth beyond gunplay. Time manipulation, possession, telekinesis and electrical abilities all transform the way you play. 

  • Campaign and Tournament modes. Fight through story-driven missions to uncover the truth in a 2 hour campaign or test your skills in Tournament mode’s Challenge levels.

  • Entirely free to play. All the action you can handle at absolutely no cost, with nothing hidden behind a paywall.

data.short_description: St. Petersburg, Florida. 2059. The city is a quarantine zone and mysterious creatures make the difference in every battle. Phantom Beasts - Redemption is a free to play cyberpunk 2.5D shooter that blends creature training with explosive, gore-filled combat that makes every second a spectacle.
